name: Power Electronics Laboratory
description: The course introduces the switching characteristics and I–V behavior of power semiconductor devices such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. It covers single-phase and three-phase uncontrolled rectifiers, as well as controlled rectifiers for AC–DC conversion. DC–DC converters are studied with emphasis on boost and flyback topologies. The course also includes single-phase and three-phase inverters, highlighting their operating principles and applications in power conversion.
